messages:
tara: ping — after last night's combined rollout (runtime 5.0.0 + SDK 7.0) we're seeing a tiny but consistent mismatch for atlas-quant-v2 where outputs misalign on multi-chunk responses (parsing downstream fails). anyone tracking?

deploybot: Deploybot: anomaly alert: parse_fail_rate=0.35% model=atlas-quant-v2 region=us-west-2 at 02:14 UTC. No pins in effect. (bot)

ryan: repro looks like off-by-one chunk boundary when sequence size crosses 2048 -> chunker boundary shifts. I can reproduce with `./smoke --model atlas-quant-v2 --seq 2050 --runtime 5.0.0 --sdk 7.0`

sdk_yelena: SDK 7.0 changed the chunk serialization to pack meta into header_v2 which altered alignment when runtime expects header_v1. We shipped a compatibility shim but it defaults off for new models to avoid perf hit.

sre_ben: initial telemetry: affected requests biased to ~60% small-batch streaming, 40% longseq. attaching short tail logs to the ticket.

tara: suggested mitigation: apply targeted SDK soft-pin to 6.9.2 for atlas-quant-v2 in us-west-2 + eu-west for 2h, keep 5% canary on 7.0 and run a compatibility shim feature flag in SDK to gate header_v2. prefer SDK pin to avoid rolling runtime back.

release_czar: agree on SDK pin first. Rollback criteria: if parse_fail_rate >0.2% for 15m in pinned regions -> escalate to full SDK rollback; if end-to-end latency regresses >12% post-pin, revert and consider runtime patch. Owners: sdk + runtime + infra-sre. Approved for 2h.

deploybot: executing: `/deploybot pin-sdk --model atlas-quant-v2 --sdk 6.9.2 --regions us-west-2,eu-west-1 --duration 2h --canary 5% --notify ops`

deploybot: Pin applied at 7801234580 :white_check_mark:

sdk_yelena: I'll flip the compatibility shim default for pinned models (feature flag `compat.header_v1=true`) and issue a tiny patch PR. will post PR link here.

sre_ben: monitoring dashboards now. initial post-pin numbers: parse_fail_rate down to 0.08% in eu-west within 4m, us-west-2 trending 0.12% after 6m.

ryan: will run extended multi-chunk smoke across both runtimes with the shim enabled and post traces.

tara: draft release note: "Applied temporary SDK pin to 6.9.2 for atlas-quant-v2 in us-west-2 & eu-west-1 to mitigate chunk-header compatibility issues observed after SDK 7.0 + runtime 5.0.0 rollout. 2h soft-pin; 5% canary retained on 7.0. Owners: SDK & Runtime."

release_czar: keeping thread open. opsbot, please post automated summary at pin end or on escalation.

opsbot: Automated follow-up scheduled at 7801235380 or on earlier pin-lift. (bot)
